meanings.heading: Three things that are not the same

carrier.title: Carrier status
carrier.body: A carrier result means a screening test found a change that can be passed on. A carrier is usually healthy. It does not mean you have the condition.

couple.title: Couple-level reproductive chance
couple.body: When both partners are confirmed carriers of relevant variants in the same autosomal recessive condition, a counsellor can explain what that may mean for each pregnancy. That couple-level chance is not the same as one person's carrier status.

diagnosis.title: A confirmed diagnosis
diagnosis.body: A screening carrier result is not a diagnosis of a condition in you or in a child. Diagnosis, if it is ever discussed, belongs with a qualified clinician.

explainer.heading: How to read a carrier note

means.title: What a carrier result means
means.body: It is information about a change that can be inherited. It is not a judgement about you, your partner, or your family.

limits.title: What this does and does not establish
limits.body: It does not establish a diagnosis. It does not predict a specific child's health. It does not rank people or couples.

partner.title: Why a partner's result may matter
partner.body: For some inherited conditions, both partners' carrier status is needed before a couple-level chance can be discussed. Sharing stays in your control.

counsellor.title: When a genetic counsellor should review this
counsellor.body: A qualified genetic counsellor can review a result, explain its limits, and discuss options. You can open Care when you are ready. There is no deadline on this page.

example.title: An autosomal recessive example
example.lead: This is a teaching example. It is not a calculation for your session, and it does not apply automatically to every condition or every couple.
example.when: When both partners are confirmed carriers of relevant variants in the same autosomal recessive condition, each pregnancy has:
example.carrier: a 50% chance of being a carrier
example.neither: a 25% chance of inheriting neither familial variant
example.independent: Each pregnancy is independent of the last.
